faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.body: Answers about therapy, recovery plans and what to expect from care.

items.question: How long does a therapy session take?
items.answer: Most sessions take around 45 to 60 minutes depending on the treatment plan.

items.question: How many sessions are needed?
items.answer: This depends on your condition, recovery goals and progress after assessment.

items.question: Is therapy treatment painful?
items.answer: Therapy should feel controlled and supportive. We adapt pressure and pace to you.

items.question: Do I need a doctor's referral?
items.answer: No. You can book directly, though referrals are welcome where relevant.
